maintainers: Marc F. Lensink (CNRS & Univ. Lille), Theo Mauri, Guillaume Brysbaert (CNRS & Univ. Lille), Shoshana J. Wodak (VUB-VIB)
references: Lensink MF, Wodak SJ. Score_set: a CAPRI benchmark for scoring protein complexes. Proteins 2014
The CAPRI scoreset 2022 update (in preparation, per site)
CAPRI round reports: CAPRI 6th/7th edition, CASP13/CASP14-CAPRI (Proteins 2017-2021)
license: Upstream rights retained. Original structural models are fetched directly from the publisher; no blanket redistribution grant is made.

sources.what: uploaded decoy sets (public inputs) + per-decoy CAPRI assessment (ground truth)
scorer submissions + per-model CAPRI assessment (participant ranking)
native target structures and target/interface metadata (private; DockQ cross-check only)

not_used: Scoreset_v2022_Predictors.tar.bz2 (1.8 GB, docking-experiment predictor models) — not needed

derived.anonymization: Targets renamed C01..C10; decoys ordered by sha256('b2-capri-scoring|target|identification'); fixed per-target rigid-body transforms seeded by sha256('b2-capri-scoring|frame|target').

distribution: Original models fetched from publisher; exact original task coordinates reconstructed with recorded rigid transforms and decimal-rounding corrections. Derived numerical assessment labels retain source attribution.
